page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; one main text column; marginal notes in the left margin; catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: portionem æqualitatis & dignitatis cum præmio ipso vitæ æternæ quod Pererius, idque in seipso absque vlla meritorum mortisue Christi ratione, quod non erubuere Suarez, & Bayus, nobis blasphemiæ proximum merito videri solet. At vero (quod moderatiores Papistæ præ se ferunt) meritum hoc nostrum meritus est Christus ; nec alia quidem opera hoc sibi vendicare possunt, quàm quæ in Deo facta; vt loquitur Andradius ; quàm tincta Christi sanguine, vt paulo elegantius nuperi Pontificiorum : Quid est nisi hoc sit fucum facere, glaucomam ve ob oculos
main_text.note: Tom.1.in Tb.3. d.11. De merit. op. l.1.c.9.

page.notes: Left margin notes are partly faint and show-through; readings of the marginal notes are approximate. A blot appears in the text near "quidem". The final line is printed as "oculos" in the text and as catchword.
